  "patch": "*** Begin Patch\n*** Update File: /Users/user_c042661f/Documents/Headless-Wan2GP/scripts/convert_lora_rank.py\n@@\n-\"\"\"\n-Convert high-rank LoRA files to lower rank using SVD truncation.\n-\n-The lightx2v Wan2.2-Distill-Loras use rank64 with .diff weights, making\n-inference ~3-5x slower than rank16/32 standard LoRAs. Keeps .diff weights for norm layers (1D, negligible cost)\n-5. Saves a new safetensors file in standard LoRA format\n-\n-Usage:\n-    python convert_lora_rank.py <input.safetensors> <output.safetensors> [--rank 32]\n-\"\"\"\n+\"\"\"Convert LoRA files to a lower rank via SVD truncation.\n+\n+Usage:\n+    python convert_lora_rank.py <input.safetensors> <output.safetensors> [--rank 32]\n+\"\"\"\n*** End Patch\n"
